name: lifecycleKit
description: Per-addon loading, readiness, and shutdown lifecycle coordination for MoltenCodes packages, with optional parts for a shared combat gate (lockdown state and bounded out-of-combat queue) and a halted state announced to dependents.
summary: Replay-aware per-addon loading, readiness and shutdown that closes the addon's scopes in the other Kits; a combat gate and halting as parts.

CombatGate.description: The combat gate: one shared lockdown state, a bounded per-addon queue of calls that wait for the end of combat, and the combat notices.

Halt.description: Halting: Halt, DependsOn and OnDependencyHalted, which tell the addons that declared a halted one.
